product.name: REIDAR chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a board and a panel
steps.instruction: Join a board and a panel (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A board and a panel are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the REIDAR chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 40 cm), B (panel, about 47 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.

steps.title: Add 2 legs and 2 panels
steps.instruction: Attach 2 legs and 2 panels (C, D, E, F) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the REIDAR chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: C (leg, about 41 cm), D (leg, about 41 cm), E (panel, about 42 cm), F (panel, about 42 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
